first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: First-person foreground person, with only both hands and parts of the forearms visible; wearing purple patterned gloves and holding Weapon A.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The light-gold handgun held by Person A, with a relatively long rectangular slide; the grip is mostly occluded by both hands.

entities.name: white locker group beside the doorway
entities.identification: A row of off-white tall cabinets to the image-left of the wide doorway with a white frame, with large red lettering and black graffiti on the doors.

entities.name: wide doorway with a white frame
entities.identification: The wide white rectangular doorframe connecting the locker room to the corridor behind it.

entities.name: rear wall with skull graffiti
entities.identification: The light-gray wall behind the wide doorway, with black skull outlines and purple lettering-shaped graffiti.

entities.name: blue-and-white safety sign
entities.identification: Two blue-and-white notice signs arranged vertically on the wall to the image-right of the wide doorway.

entities.name: Person G
entities.identification: A small dark human figure in the distant inner doorway, emerging from behind an occluding edge, moving toward the lower image-left, and then being occluded again by the wall edge.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The light-beige wall around the doorframe and cabinet group, with vertical divisions and a dark baseboard.

entities.name: gray-brown locker-room floor
entities.identification: The gray-brown foreground floor, with a yellow zigzag boundary along the facilities by the wall.

entities.name: indoor metal grid ceiling
entities.identification: The dark-gray grating and intersecting support beams visible along the upper edge of the image.

entities.name: long overhead light fixture
entities.identification: The white strip-shaped light fixture in the ceiling area, with its illuminated portion visible above the inside of the doorway.

entities.name: metal sink by the wall
entities.identification: The light-gray metal fixture cropped at the far image-right, retaining its shared identity, with only its edge and part of its side visible.

entities.name: white protective suit
entities.identification: The group of white garments hanging on the left wall, including a long-sleeved, long-legged coverall and a shorter garment beside it.

entities.name: white round helmet
entities.identification: The two white domed helmets above the hanging garments on the left.

entities.name: black hanging rod
entities.identification: The slender dark horizontal hanging rod above the garments on the left wall.

entities.name: wood-colored bench
entities.identification: The bench below the garments on the left, with a long, narrow wood-colored seat and partially visible light-gray supports.

entities.name: gray corridor floor
entities.identification: The gray-blue floor behind the wide doorway, with a yellow zigzag line and a dark-gray rectangular cover-like area.

entities.name: vertically striped corridor side wall
entities.identification: The gray wall on the image-right inside the wide doorway, with vertical lines and tubular components.

entities.name: light-gray wall-mounted box
entities.identification: The small light-gray wall-mounted box below the blue-and-white safety sign, with a horizontal area on the upper part and a light-colored rectangular label on the lower part.

entities.name: white muzzle smoke
entities.identification: The white-gray smoke spreading in front of Weapon A and within the line of sight through the doorway after Weapon A fires.

entities.name: scattered white papers in the corridor
entities.identification: The white flat sheet-like object on the corridor floor, with a quadrilateral projection.
